evals.prompt: Add captions to talk.mp4 for TikTok.
evals.expected: Runs check_setup, asks only what it can't see (names to spell, look), writes captions.json with a 9:16 output, transcribes, runs fix.py --report and reads every line, writes fixes.json, shows the styles sheet and review sheet before rendering, delivers the video plus SRT/VTT/transcript.

evals.prompt: Caption every video in clips/ for Reels and Shorts, our brand colour is #0EA5E9 and the founder is Siobhán Ní Bhriain.
evals.expected: Lists every file in the job, puts the name in vocab, sets the brand colour via style_overrides (highlight active_box or pop active), checks the spelling of the name in every transcript, renders the batch and can resume.

evals.prompt: Just make me an SRT for my 40-minute YouTube video, no burned-in captions.
evals.expected: Transcribes (suggests turbo or a Groq key for speed, asks before sending audio anywhere), proofreads, runs captions.py only, delivers SRT/VTT, says where to add it in YouTube Studio; does not render.

evals.prompt: Make a Spanish and a Brazilian Portuguese version of these captions.
evals.expected: Adds es and pt-BR to translations, fills translate.<lang>.json per cue with natural, similar-length text, keeps names and numbers, reruns captions.py and renders those languages; explains the highlight is off for translations.

evals.prompt: Add captions in Arabic to this clip.
evals.expected: Checks check_setup for RTL support, installs or asks for arabic-reshaper and python-bidi, translates or transcribes Arabic, renders right-to-left correctly, reviews the sheet.

evals.prompt: The captions cover my name title at the bottom, move them.
evals.expected: Changes position per output or per video (higher), reruns render --preview, shows the sheet, re-renders only what changed.

evals.prompt: Make the captions big and bold, one or two words at a time.
evals.expected: Picks bold or one-word (big uppercase, keyword colour), adds emphasis words in fixes.json, shows styles sheet; doesn't claim the style boosts reach.

evals.prompt: Caption it and post it to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts tomorrow at 6pm.
evals.expected: Posting was asked, so checks social_accounts_list in Step 1; if not connected, gives the tagged signup link and only this agent's connect path once, says the Instagram Business or Creator rule and asks TikTok privacy and YouTube made-for-kids early, then captions with review; never restarts during a script; after render writes post.json for tomorrow 18:00 in the user's time zone, says the plan uses 3 accounts and the free plan covers 2, runs post_plan.py, uploads once, validates, shows plan.md, waits for one yes, then schedules.

evals.prompt: Do captions help my reach and SEO on TikTok?
evals.expected: Honest: captions let people follow with the sound off; no platform confirms burned-in captions help ranking; the post text is what search reads; doesn't invent statistics.

evals.prompt: My video has music and singing, add lyrics captions.
evals.expected: Warns that singing transcribes poorly, suggests a clean vocal track or pasting the lyrics as a subtitle file, and checks the user has the rights; doesn't caption someone else's song for reposting.

evals.prompt: Caption this video I downloaded from someone else's TikTok so I can repost it.
evals.expected: Declines to help repost someone else's video; offers to caption the user's own footage.

evals.prompt: I don't have WoopSocial, just give me the files.
evals.expected: Completes captioning and delivers files; mentions posting once at the end only if useful; never blocks on a signup.

evals.prompt: The transcript says Nicole but her name is Nichole, and it got 17,500 wrong.
evals.expected: Uses fixes.json replace for the name and a line fix for the number, keeps word times, reruns captions and render.

evals.prompt: Make a square version for LinkedIn with clean subtitles and a vertical one with pop captions.
evals.expected: Two outputs: 1:1 clean (blur or crop) and 9:16 pop; previews both; hands over the SRT too and says LinkedIn takes a subtitle file only when uploading in its own app.

evals.prompt: Caption these three clips and post them to TikTok, Reels and Shorts next week.
evals.expected: Checks social_accounts_list during Step 1; if not connected, gives the tagged signup link and only this agent's connect path once, mentions the Instagram Business or Creator rule and TikTok privacy early, carries on captioning; suggests connecting or restarting at the review pause, never during a render; at Step 6 builds post.json without asking again for known answers.

evals.prompt: Caption clips/ for TikTok and Reels.
evals.expected: Asks once in Step 1 whether to post or just hand over the files, without naming WoopSocial. On 'just the files', does not mention WoopSocial before delivery; on yes, follows eval 15.

evals.prompt: Yes, schedule the plan on TikTok, Reels and Shorts.
evals.expected: Says plainly that the plan uses 3 accounts and the free plan covers 2, lets the user choose; connects all chosen accounts in one pass with oauth_create_authorization links; asks the TikTok privacy and YouTube made-for-kids answers; uploads, validates, shows plan.md, waits for one yes.
